Garage description
Using spruce from sustainable-only areas, the "Needle" paint is prepared using 25 square meters of spruce, cut down and shredded into miniature wooden needles, and bound together using a special type of resin.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Paint first appeared on September 22, 2011.
Prior to the Paint Separation Update, Needle was worth 210,000 crystals and could be bought from the rank of Fieldmarshal.
Legacy paint description:
A paint that offers decent protection against Smoky and somewhat reduces the damage inflicted by Ricochet and Shaft. Good for mid to long-range battles. Allows the tank good camouflage while in coniferous forests.
